protocol.evaluation: Official Test50 queries (LeWM eval.py seed-42 sample), 50-step planning budget, goal 25 steps ahead. In each shift condition only the observation is shifted; the goal image is clean.
protocol.video: Replay of the actions executed in the recorded Test run inside the native simulator; no re-planning and no model inference. Panels show the model-input frame of that condition (same appearance operation as the Test hook); the centre shows the goal image given to both models. A successful episode stops at its success step.
protocol.fidelity: A clip is kept only if, for both models, replaying all 50 queries of that condition reproduces the recorded success vector exactly (and the per-step physical trace and initial simulator state).
protocol.severity_runs: Strength clips replay the strength-sweep Test50 runs of the paper figure (same weights as the main table, same protocol, CPU execution); their rates are those of that sweep level.
protocol.layout: left: LeWM | centre: goal (not shifted) | right: LeWM + LeNS-JEPA
protocol.paths: src and poster are relative to the project page root.

selection_rules.gallery: For each task and observation shift (Gray, Hue, Blur, Noise, C-B): official Test50 queries where LeWM + LeNS-JEPA succeeds and LeWM fails, excluding the query already shown as the featured demo clip, and requiring that LeWM + LeNS-JEPA needs at least 8 environment steps to succeed (no trivial starts); up to 4 such queries in ascending Test index. If fewer exist, all eligible queries are shown.
selection_rules.clean2: In-distribution (no shift): for each task, the first two Test50 queries (ascending index) where both models succeed and LeWM + LeNS-JEPA needs at least 10 environment steps.
selection_rules.failure2: Honesty clips: for each task, up to 2 further Test50 queries where LeWM succeeds and LeWM + LeNS-JEPA fails (excluding the existing failure clip), taking shifts in the order Gray, Hue, Blur, Noise, C-B and then ascending index.
selection_rules.severity: Shift-strength sweeps of the paper with the same LeWM / LeWM + LeNS-JEPA weights (TwoRoom blur sigma in {0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4} px; PushT hue rotation in {0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180} degrees; Reacher noise std in {0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.09, 0.12, 0.20}). For each task, the strongest level with at least one query where LeWM + LeNS-JEPA succeeds and LeWM fails; up to 2 such queries, lowest Test indices first.
